column1: # Dependencies whose documentation cannot be resolved (or verified) the usual way.
# Why this file exists: the skill requires every CHANGELOG link to point at the
# specific version and to be verified against the page. A few vendors publish
# release notes that either have no per-version page at all, or render the recent
# entries with JavaScript so a plain fetch never sees the version. Without this
# list the flow would stop and ask the maintainer for a URL on every single
#   1. alias-glob        matched against the CHANGELOG entry name (used by
#   3. url-template      URL to use, with placeholders {version},
#                        "-" means: no template, resolve the URL as usual and
#                        skip-version-check  page need not mention the version,
#                                            and the URL itself need not carry it
#                        skip-anchor-check   #anchor need not exist in the HTML
#                        skip-reachability   ignore the HTTP status (host blocks
# First matching row wins — put specific aliases above broad globs.
